thread:
Maya (netops): FYI we're seeing a spike in 429s and streaming disconnects for hosted-api in eu-west-1 starting ~14:05 UTC. Correlates with an ingress config push 14:02.
AlertBot: [ALERT] 429 rate > baseline x10 on ingress-proxy-eu1 for 3m.
Jordan (oncall): rolling back last ingress-nginx config in eu-west-1 now. Which change went out?
Tiago (prod): deploy includes nginx rewrite rule to normalize path prefixes for a subset of legacy routes. Looks harmless but could interact with rate-limit annotations.
Maya (netops): logs show rewrite is setting upstream path to "/v1/stream" for long-polling routes which matches a strict per-route rate-limit in the new config. That caused per-client buckets to hit 429.
CustomerOps: flagged ~8 customers reporting stream resets and 429s, some on websockets fallbacks. Sending updates.
Jordan (oncall): rollback complete at 14:11. 429s dropped ~70% in rollback pool.
SRE Bot: [METRIC] ingress-proxy-eu1 429s: 14:06 200/min -> 14:12 60/min -> 14:30 5/min.
Tiago (prod): immediate hotfix: patch ingress to preserve original path header for long-polling routes and add explicit rate-limit-exempt annotation for /v1/stream. Pushing canary to two pods.
Maya (netops): canary looks good, no 429s on canary. Starting gradual rollout.
CustomerOps: notified customers of mitigation and provided retry/backoff guidance, one customer switched to dedicated and unaffected.
Jordan (oncall): after roll complete 14:38, all regions normalized. Adding follow-up: audit ingress rule linting to catch rate-limit mismatches.
Marisol: creating incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1811002000 and status page update: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1811002000. Adding timeline and customer names for CS.
Tiago (prod): root cause: deploy combined path rewrite + per-route rate-limit without cross-checking for streaming endpoints. Action items: 1) add automated lint in CI for rewrite+rate-limit combos, 2) add canary gating for ingress changes that affect routes with streaming flag, 3) update deploy checklist.
Maya (netops): we will keep enhanced monitoring for 2h. If anything regresses reopen.
Jordan (oncall): marking as mitigated. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
SRE Bot: [CLOSED] Incident mitigated at 14:40 UTC.
